segments.text: A year after Israel started vaccinating people, they said, hey, we should get serious about the safety data because people are asking questions.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: So they recruited a top-notch team of Israeli scientists to design the collection system, to collect the data, and see how safe it was.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: So they started doing that, and about two months into it, they report, hey, we've got a problem here.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: This vaccine is not safe.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: We're seeing these safety signals.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: It's not the final report.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: We'll have that in June of 2022, because it started in, basically, early 2022.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: They reported that, and the Israeli government said, hey, thanks very much, we'll let people know.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And then when they met in June with the final report on the first five most frequent adverse events, they asked, they said, hey, how come you didn't tell the Israeli people?
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: What was going on?
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: We told you this thing is throwing out safety signals and these side effects are serious and they're caused by the vaccine.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: How come you never see anything?
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: So what did they do?
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: They sat on it for two months and then issued a report saying there's nothing to see here.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: So that would be the end of it, except for one little problem.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: One of the people on the meeting recorded the call and it shows that the Ministry of Health was informed that these vaccines are not safe and effective and it showed that the vaccine is actually causing harm in lots of different areas that have not been reported or recognized by the drug companies or the FDA or anybody else.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: So, super troubling result.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: So, reporter gets her hands on it, and she asks the media, hey, anybody want to see the tapes?
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And nobody is interested in seeing the tapes.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: There's no investigation on the Israeli Ministry of Health for burying that information.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: The only place that takes it, that wants to take the story, is GB News.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Neil Oliver at GB News.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: These guys are the only ones that want to promote the story.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And then the Epic Times says, we want to see the data too.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: So we arranged to have a private briefing for the Epic Times.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: They come in with someone who speaks Hebrew so they can verify everything that was said, and they write up four stories on it.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Epic Times and GB News, that's it.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Total News blackout everywhere else.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: How can you have
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: a safety study on a vaccine which people are being mandated to take showing significant adverse events and nobody wants to see the data.
